opening.argument: Post Malone takes Jimmy Fallon to Olive Garden for a comedic restaurant visit, with the conversation centered on food, wine, and the experience itself. The segment includes a playful breadstick demonstration and an order of chicken parmesan. The speakers say neither was monetarily compensated by Olive Garden. Nothing in the cited material turns the restaurant visit into a financial offer; the end-screen requests to subscribe or watch more clips are ordinary channel engagement, not a promise of payment or returns.

citations.quote: Post Malone Takes Jimmy Fallon to Olive Garden
I'm gonna show you how to do the olive garden breadstick Post Malone-style.
And we'll take two chicken parmesans, extra crispy.
I've not been monetarily compensated by Olive Garden to do or say anything.
